## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-fascicle Táng Cí'ēn-school sub-commentary by [慧沼](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%B2%BC) **Huìzhǎo** (650–714), Kuījī's principal disciple and the second patriarch of the Cí'ēn-school, on his teacher's [KR6n0124](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0124) *Dàshèng fǎyuàn yìlín zhāng* 大乘法苑義林章. Preserved in the *Manji Xuzangjing* 卍續藏 at X55n0882 (= ZB6n0113). The function-marker *bǔquè* 補闕 ("filling the gaps") indicates that the work supplies essays on topics where Kuījī's parent compendium was either silent or compressed beyond clarity.

**Abstract**

The *Bǔquè* is the single most important Cí'ēn-school sub-commentary on the *Yìlín zhāng*, supplementing Kuījī's coverage with detailed expositions of doctrinal topics (the *abhidharma*-school traditional categories of *sānkē*, the analytic of *dé* / *fēidé* in *abhidharma* psychology, the Yogācāra reading of the twelve-link *pratītyasamutpāda*) where Kuījī's text is either silent or compressed. The work is a key witness to the second-generation Cí'ēn-school's effort to consolidate Kuījī's compendium into a complete doctrinal reference.

[慧沼](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%B2%BC) Huìzhǎo (650–714, *zì* Xuánshū 玄樞, sobriquet **Zīēnsì** 淄恩寺 / Sūshēngsì 蘇生寺) was Kuījī's chief disciple and the second patriarch of the Cí'ēn-school, succeeding Kuījī at *Cí'ēnsì* and later moving to *Dàyúnsì* 大雲寺. His full corpus includes [KR6n0127](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0127) *Quànfā pútí xīn jí* 勸發菩提心集 (T45n1862) and [KR6n0128](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0128) *Néng xiǎn zhōngbiān huìrì lùn* 能顯中邊慧日論 (T45n1863). The dating window 682 (Kuījī's death) to 714 (Huìzhǎo's death) is the period within which Huìzhǎo could have composed the *Bǔquè*.
